svg.title: basis system architecture: code city
svg.text: A code city of the repository, drawn as a site plan. Each building
is a source module and each floor is 100 lines of code. Bridges are
basis: document traceability for civil engineering
Keyless gateway, project API, storage, launcher
JSON persistence, query history and caches
Cited answers, synthesis, numeric and applicability checks
Ranks provisions, table rows and editions
PDF text, geometry, tables and OCR to evidence units
Reference standards, project packages, IFC models
Building = module (≥ 50 lines) · Floor line = 100 lines · Tank = data store · Bridge = interface
HTTPS via Vercel rewrite and tunnel; keyless /local-api gateway adds the device key
Projects, findings, query history and imports as JSON on disk
Pollable query job over an index scoped to the active project
Lookup and ranking of provisions, table rows and editions
Evidence units: verbatim rows and sentences with PDF regions
PyMuPDF extraction, table recovery, Tesseract OCR, edition catalog
